payload.claim: The spec's frontmatter has no `risk:` field at all, even though `touches` includes `saffron/cell/session.py`, which matches `policy.yaml`'s `elevate_on: saffron/cell/**`. This will make `effective_risk` resolve to `elevated` at run time regardless of the omission (computed from the actual changed files, not the declaration), flipping the `size` gate from advisory to blocking. This has no practical consequence here since the measured source diff (289 tokens) is well under the `bug` ceiling of 1300 either way, and there is repo precedent for omitting the field entirely while touching that same path (e.g. `done/SA-0113-no-session-names-the-edit-a-claim-rests-on.md`), so this is not a deviation from a hard rule, just worth an operator's passing awareness.
